# Forum post — Discussion summary

*Posted after the webinar, as a reply under the announcement thread. A synthesis of the post-talk discussion — not a literal transcript.*

## How to produce it

1. Save the Zoom live transcript of the discussion (`.txt`).
2. Generate a summary with an LLM, using the prompt below.
3. Review, edit, and post it under the announcement thread.

## LLM prompt

> I want a summary, in English, to post on The Example Collective as a reply under the post that announced the talk. State that the talk is available on YouTube at {{youtube_link}}, and that we are summarising the discussion that took place after the talk. Format the text so it reads coherently as a forum post — not a literal transcript, but a synthesis: give the necessary context, be diplomatic, and organise the discussion coherently.

## Post structure

- One line: the talk is now on YouTube — {{youtube_link}}.
- A short, organised synthesis of the discussion: the main themes, the key questions, and the speaker's answers.
- An invitation to continue the conversation on the thread.
